head.t: RPA Dental Equipment wins £38.5k digital X-ray unit replacement at Betsi Cadwaladr
head.x: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board has direct-awarded RPA Dental Equipment Limited a £38,500 contract for seven digital X-ray units across its community dental sites, called off under the NHS Supply Chain Dental Technologies, Implants and Related Consumables and Services framework.
